scope: Bounded nested GNOME Wayland compositor, PipeWire, and portal service probe

commands.command: Xvfb :99; dbus-run-session; gnome-shell --nested --wayland --no-x11; pipewire; wireplumber; xdg-desktop-portal; xdg-desktop-portal-gnome
commands.assertions: GNOME Shell 46.2 created the nested Wayland socket and AT-SPI registry. PipeWire started, but the GNOME screencast service failed to initialize and the portal backend aborted.
The portal service did not expose Screenshot/ScreenCast interfaces; no capture response or input effect was produced.

limitations: GNOME Shell reported an incompatible nested display and failed to initialize org.gnome.Shell.Screencast; the portal backend then aborted.
This is an environment probe only and does not prove NAT-06 or the GNOME support row.
